Name: Lyrics
Author: sVanitas
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]music lyric overlay for Stardew Valley. It reads the currently playing track from your Windows media session and displays time-synced lyrics in-game. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod folder.[/color][/*]
[*]Place the folder in your stardew valley mods folder[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Display synced lyrics in a compact music player or floating in front of your farmer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Show album artwork, track title, artist, and playback progress.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Control previous track, play/pause, and next track from the in-game player.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Choose the player’s screen corner and lyric color, including an accent color sampled from the album art.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or newer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Windows 10 or newer and a media app that exposes playback information through the Windows media session.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Internet access for LRCLIB lyric lookups.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional; without it, settings can be edited in[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Inspired by lyrics minecraft mod[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Lyrics HUD
Manifest.Description: A Windows-only music lyric overlay for Stardew Valley. Shows synced lyrics in a compact player or floating in front of your farmer, with album-art colors and playback controls.
Manifest.Author: Bekir
